name: Replication data for: Scoring from Contests
description: battles.csv -- The matrix of contest participants from the example in the appendix outcomes.vsv -- The matrix of contest outcomes from the example in the appendix scoring.R -- The R functions that implement the scoring method and check for pairwise comparability conditions + use `source("scoring.R")' to access the score() and check.similarity() functions Examples.R -- Some examples that show how to use the functions in scoring.R, including the example in the appendix of the paper thermometer.R -- code to run the feeling thermometer examples on the national data. Reproduces figures 1 and 2 thermometerTX.R -- code to run thermometer example with bootstrapping on data fror Texas democrats. Reproduces Figure 3.
citation: Schnakenberg, Keith, 2013, "Replication data for: Scoring from Contests", https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/V4V0AU, Harvard Dataverse, V2
